name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.database.ui.prefs.SharedPreferencesDetailsActivity
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. This BigBrother screen opens after a preference file is selected in the diagnostic browser and displays that file's stored values.
disableEffect: You will not be able to inspect preference-file contents in BigBrother; the app's preferences continue to work.
